title: People Only Change When They Feel Like It
coreMove: Adults change when the want becomes theirs, so pleading and ultimatums mostly buy resistance. Drop the pressure and free your love for influence that can land.

exampleSpecs.domain: Source case: Friend's husband and health
exampleSpecs.audience: Dina and readers facing internal motivation
exampleSpecs.stakes: Even loving pressure can create a standoff when the change does not yet feel personally chosen.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show Dina using internal motivation in the source case without controlling another person.
